title: Contract Payment Count Points for Installment Settlements, Deficiency Balance Accounts
content:
**Schedule.** The premium contract payments of an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts are the payments of the installment type posted on the ledger of the contract that produced the account, as recorded under Retail Installment Contracts, less the payments returned on that contract's ledger. Fewer than 12 premium contract payments add 4.0 surcharge points to an installment settlement, at least 12 but fewer than 30 add 2.0 points, and 30 or more add no points. The points are percentage points of the balance.

| Premium contract payments | Surcharge points |
|---|---|
| 0 to 11 | 4.0 |
| 12 to 29 | 2.0 |
| 30 or more | None |

## How the count is formed

- Only the liquidated contract recorded on the Deficiency Balance Account is read.
- Posted payments count only when their payment type is installment; payoff, reinstatement, redemption, insurance-settlement and sale-proceeds payments do not.
- Every returned payment on the contract is taken off, whatever payment it returned.

## Worked counts (hypothetical)

| Installment payments posted | Returned | Count | Points |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | 3 | 11 | 4.0 |
| 14 | 2 | 12 | 2.0 |
| 33 | 4 | 29 | 2.0 |
| 33 | 3 | 30 | None |
